description: Ferrum Edge's closed error vocabularies: the granular ErrorClass (access-log error_class, ferrum_requests_total{error_class}, stream disconnect metrics) and the eight coarse client-facing X-Gateway-Error tokens. The header token is a stable contract and must not change spelling.

surfaces.values: error_classes plus the tokens whose metric_label_without_error_class is true

error_classes.meaning: TCP connect refused (port not listening, firewall RST), including connect-phase RSTs. A TLS handshake failure after TCP connect is tls_error, not this class.
A backend read or write exceeded its per-direction timeout.

x_gateway_error_tokens.meaning: Pre-wire connect, DNS or TLS failure: the gateway could not set up a connection to the backend. Also the token for every ErrorClass whose request_reached_wire is false.
A backend held the request (it accepted the connection and was sent the request) but did not answer in time. Never used for a timeout no backend held.
